notes.title: Living With a Little Fox Girl is now available to wishlist!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021791/57ab870f7d6ce08ace507539d7867c1902b7d973.png
Hello, everyone!

We’re delighted to reveal our next upcoming release Living With a Little Fox Girl!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3845600/Living_With_a_Little_Fox_Girl/

Care for a local shrine and befriend Mao, the fox girl who lives there. In this light-hearted simulation game, you’ll have 30 days to balance your time between your tasks and building a relationship with Mao. Use your time wisely, and who knows? Maybe she'll let you stay longer.

Should you enjoy our games, consider joining us on Discord and following our Steam Publisher Page for all the latest news from Saikey Studios!

More from us:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3478020/Living_with_my_Little_Sister/

notes.title: Exposed Livestream is now available to purchase!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021791/f5d11c7e4e440944be732525fcc6390f5ac149a4.png

We’re overjoyed to announce the official release of Exposed Livestream, developed by Kumada Gaon! The game is available right now, with a special 20% off launch discount! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3304770/Exposed_Livestream/

Trailer:
[previewyoutube=1OnJGS2UXmM;full][/previewyoutube]

Stream by day, prank by night, and build your fame in this RPG adventure game! As IRL streamer Laika, create content, earn subscribers, and expand your skills. Explore the city and risk it all to entertain your growing audience. Show them what they actually want to see...
